messages: Looks like #p218# has another favor to ask.

#b#p218##k asked me to go to #b#m010000013##k, take out #r#o0700004##k, and bring back its #b#t2210000##k. So you get to stay here while I do all the work for you again? Don't you think that's a bit much? Maybe I'll just keep the #b#t2210000##k for myself!

The #b#t2210000##k wasn’t an item that makes dreams come true. It turns people who use it into snails. Phew… learned a good lesson not to believe in rumors, otherwise I would be the one crawling about.
name: A rainbow snail shell that makes wishes come true!?
demandSummary: Bring the #t2210000# to #b#p218##k or use the #t2210000#, then talk to #b#p218##k.
